rxz · ROBLOX ANIMATION + CUTSCENES
==================================

One Claude Code skill, in one folder. Free.

1. Copy the whole folder this file is in — roblox-animation — into the folder
   Claude Code reads:
     Windows         C:\Users\<you>\.claude\skills
     macOS / Linux   ~/.claude/skills

   The result must be exactly:
     .claude\skills\roblox-animation\SKILL.md

2. Restart Claude Code.

3. Ask for a clip or a scene:
     "make a 0.5s right cross for my R15 fighter, it must beat the walk cycle"
     "build a five-shot intro: gate, two lines of dialogue, then push in"
     "this run cycle pops at the loop — fix it"

No installer, no PowerShell, no admin, no key, no account.

You need Python 3.11+ with Pillow (pip install Pillow) for the contact sheet.
Everything else is stdlib. Roblox Studio is needed for the last mile: playing
the clip, checking the marker, and publishing the asset.

If the rxz Roblox Skills pack is also installed, remove its roblox-animation
folder first: this skill uses the same name and a different pipeline.
